summary: Closes every socket in a network socket array. Reads the entry count from this+0x6C; when positive, iterates the array whose base pointer is this+0x8, calling closesocket on the socket handle at each entry and advancing by a fixed 28-byte stride per entry. Always returns 0. Called by sub_563AB0.

local_names.count: socket entry count read from this+0x6C
local_names.base: socket array base pointer read from this+0x8
local_names.off: byte offset into the array, advanced by 28 per entry

operations.description: Enter the loop only when the signed count at this+0x6C is greater than 0; otherwise skip and return 0.
do/while loop running exactly count times; each pass closes one socket and advances the byte offset by 28.
closesocket(*(_DWORD *)(base + off)); dereference the array entry at this+0x8 plus the running offset and close the socket handle stored at entry offset 0.
Per iteration: i += 1 and off += 28; continue while i < count.
Return 0 in both the empty and non-empty cases.
